spec.rawSql:
SELECT SUM(market_cap_usd) AS total_market_cap
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary;

SELECT
    symbol AS "Asset",
    price_usd AS "Price (USD)",
    price_change_24h_pct AS "24h Change (%)",
    stream_price_change_pct AS "Stream Change (%)",
    volume_change_pct AS "Volume Change (%)",
    rolling_price_volatility AS "Volatility (%)",
    market_signal AS "Market Signal"
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary
ORDER BY market_cap_rank;

SELECT
    symbol,
    ROUND(
        (volume_24h_usd / NULLIF(market_cap_usd, 0)) * 100,
        2
    ) AS volume_market_cap_ratio
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary
ORDER BY volume_market_cap_ratio DESC;

SELECT
  timestamp AS time,
  CONCAT(symbol, ' Rolling Range') AS metric,
  ROUND(
    ((rolling_max_price - rolling_min_price)
    / NULLIF(rolling_avg_price, 0)) * 100,
    4
  ) AS value
FROM crypto_window_analytics
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT SUM(volume_24h_usd) AS total_24h_volume
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT symbol) AS assets_monitored
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary;

WITH price_data AS (
    SELECT
        id,
        timestamp,
        symbol,
        price_usd,
        FIRST_VALUE(price_usd) OVER (
            PARTITION BY symbol
            ORDER BY timestamp, id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING
        ) AS first_price
    FROM crypto_market_data
    WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
),
normalized AS (
    SELECT
        timestamp,
        symbol,
        (price_usd / first_price) * 100 AS normalized_price
    FROM price_data
)
SELECT
    timestamp AS time,
    MAX(CASE WHEN symbol = 'BTC' THEN normalized_price END) AS BTC,
    MAX(CASE WHEN symbol = 'ETH' THEN normalized_price END) AS ETH,
    MAX(CASE WHEN symbol = 'SOL' THEN normalized_price END) AS SOL,
    MAX(CASE WHEN symbol = 'XRP' THEN normalized_price END) AS XRP,
    MAX(CASE WHEN symbol = 'DOGE' THEN normalized_price END) AS DOGE
FROM normalized
GROUP BY timestamp
ORDER BY timestamp ASC;

SELECT
  symbol,
  price_change_24h_pct
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary
WHERE symbol IN (${asset:sqlstring})
ORDER BY price_change_24h_pct DESC;

SELECT
    symbol,
    market_cap_usd
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary
ORDER BY market_cap_usd DESC;

SELECT
    symbol,
    volume_24h_usd
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary
ORDER BY volume_24h_usd DESC;

SELECT
    symbol,
    rolling_price_volatility
FROM dashboard_crypto_summary
ORDER BY rolling_price_volatility DESC;
